findings.title: IAM Role Available to Compute Service That Can Escalate Privileges
findings.impact: An attacker with access to the compute service can gain administrative access.
findings.description: The IAM Role sample-instance-role can be assumed by ec2.amazonaws.com and can reach the IAM Role sample-admin-role via iam:PassRole.
findings.recommendation: Restrict iam:PassRole on sample-instance-role to the roles it needs.
